title: After an API 401 on a Drive popup session, a fresh adapter can reuse the old refused popup token for one more request while the page is signed out
evidence: Codex re-check R2 on PR 1554: the 401 raise zeroes only the live adapter's in-memory expiry; the stored popup token keeps its future expiry, and the popup exception in drive.ts getToken lets any unexpired popup grant through while signed out, so a fresh adapter (the picker's copy-down) sends one request that 401s again. No data or privacy effect. Fix: on the 401 raise also zero the stored popup expiry, so only a newly saved grant passes; pin an early 401 then a fresh adapter making no request, beside the popup reconnect lift. Owner: a lead near the top, 2026-11-13
